original_en:
Hear ye, hear ye, o weary travelers!
The traveling salesman is here to serve!

speaker: Merchant
original_jp: またのご利用 心からお待ちにしております！
original_en: I look forward to our next meeting!

original_en:
Hmm...the volcanic caverns to the south?
There's still magma flowing through there. <PART>
---
Unless you want to die and meet a valkyrie,
I recommend against taking the trip!

speaker: Adventurer
original_jp: この辺で魔物が出そうな場所って知らない？ちょっと欲しい素材があるのよ
original_en:
Where can I find monsters around here?
I need a certain material.

speaker: Adventurer
original_jp: 〓〓か… ねえ お〓の中で弓闘士とか魔術師の〓〓者とかいない？ <PART> 弓闘士と魔術師を〓めてグルー〓を構成すれば人数に関わらず〓程が最大になるし <PART> 〓い中 わざわざ〓り回らなくても戦闘を有利に進められるはずなんだけど…
original_en:
Liquid hot magma... Say, are any of
your customers archers or sorcerers? <PART>
---
A group containing archers or sorcerers
gives the best attack range. <PART>
---
Not having to run around in the heat
will be advantageous in battle.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: あいにく 今はお〓がいなくてね～ご期待に〓えられそうにも無いなぁ
original_en:
Sadly, there aren't many customers, and it
doesn't look likely to change anytime soon.

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: まったく… 〓〓者ってヤツはどうして危〓に〓び込みたがるんだろうねえ <PART> この間も 宝を求めて火山〓〓に向かったヤツが居たけれど 帰っちゃこなかったよ
original_en:
I just don't understand adventurer types!
Why must they throw themselves at danger? <PART>
---
A treasure hunter went to the caverns
the other day, but he never came back.

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: 宝を求めて命を捨てるハメになっちまったら元も子も無いと思うんだがねえ
original_en:
Throw your life away chasing treasure,
and you'll be left with nothing!

speaker: Merchant
original_jp: おおっと いらっしゃいませ！旅から旅への行〓人でございます！
original_en:
Look who we have here! A customer?
The traveling salesman is here to serve!

speaker: Merchant
original_jp: またのご利用 心からお待ちしております！
original_en: I look forward to our next meeting!

speaker: Adventurer
original_jp: クレルモンフェランが傭兵を〓ってたんで参加したんだが すぐに遠〓〓練に出されてよお <PART> こんな砂漠で戦闘〓練なんざ冗談じゃねえっつーの
original_en:
Crell Monferaigne were hiring troops, so
I signed on. The drills started right after. <PART>
---
Battle drills in the middle of the
desert are not my idea of fun.

speaker: Adventurer
original_jp: 適当に時間潰して〓練サ求って楽してお手当てを貫うぜ 俺は
original_en:
I'll just cut the drills, kill time, and
take my money, thank you very much.

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: なあ どっかで何かあったのか？旅人が騒いでいるんだが…
original_en:
Did something happen somewhere?
The travelers are raising a ruckus.

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: ディパンって〓の方の国だろ？〓者が居るとか色々噂は聞くけどねえ…
original_en:
Dipan is that country way up north, right?
I heard that they had mages or something...

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 〓まりかしら？〓めのいい部屋が空いてますよ
original_en:
Will you be staying?
We have a room with a view available.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: いらっしゃいませ お〓りですか？
original_en: Welcome. Would you like a room?

speaker: Owner
original_jp: おっと 〓まりのお〓かな？
original_en: Oh my, guests looking for a room?

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 旅人さんだね 〓まっていくかい？
original_en: Yer travelers, right? Ya gonna stay?

speaker: Owner
original_jp: いらっしゃーいええと 〓まり…よね？
original_en:
Greetings and Salutations. You look like
you're looking for a room. Am I right?

speaker: Owner
original_jp: ようこそお出で下さいましたお〓りでしょうか？
original_en:
It is an honor to receive your visit.
Shall I book your room?

speaker: Owner
original_jp: そうですか…またの機会をお待ちしてますね
original_en:
That's a shame.
Come back if you change your mind.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 機会がありましたら〓非当〓をご利用下さい
original_en:
Please visit us again,
when you have the chance.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: なんじゃ 久しぶりの〓かと思ったのにのう…
original_en: It figures. And I got all worked up.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: おや 〓やかしは御免だよ
original_en: Be on yer way then, no loiterin'.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 何だ 残念～ウチはサービスいいのに
original_en:
Well, it's your loss.
You're missing out on great service.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: ご縁がありましたらまたいらして下さいね
original_en:
If ever the opportunity should arise,
please pay us your custom again.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 波の〓は〓りを誘う子守〓ごゆっくりお〓み下さい
original_en:
Let the lullaby of the waves
be your invitation to slumber.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: それでは どうぞごゆっくりとお〓み下さい
original_en: Please enjoy your stay.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: おお そうか〓まるかゆっくり〓んどくれよ
original_en:
So you're really staying?
Take a load off!

speaker: Owner
original_jp: シーツは洗い立てだからね気持ちよく〓れるよ！
original_en:
I just cleaned the sheets.
Yer gonna sleep like a baby!

speaker: Owner
original_jp: ご〓大〓りサービスするわねごゆっくり～
original_en:
Balanced breakfast on the house!
Sleep tight.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: お疲れでしょう？ゆっくりしていって下さいね
original_en:
You must be exhausted.
Please make yourself comfortable.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: いってらっしゃいませ海の女神の加護があらんことを
original_en:
Visit again soon!
May the blessings of the sea be with you.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: ご利用ありがとうございましたお気をつけて
original_en:
Thank you for your patronage.
Please take care.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 近くに来たら また〓っておくれよ
original_en: Come by any time you're in the area.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: ぐっすり〓れたろ？気をつけていっておいで！
original_en:
Ya got a good night's rest, didn't ya?
Watch yer back out there!

speaker: Owner
original_jp: ふふ ゆっくり出来た？ また来てね～
original_en: Hehe, did you sleep okay? Come again soon!

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 疲れは取れましたか？お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ
original_en:
I trust you rested well.
We look forward to serving you again soon.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: あら 宿〓〓がちょっと足りないみたい…
original_en: Uh-oh, you don't have enough money.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 宿〓〓をお支払いになれませんとお〓めする事が難しいのですが…
original_en:
I'm afraid it would be impossible to allow
you to stay without paying the proper fee.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: なんじゃ 金が無きゃ〓められんぞ
original_en: Oh, this won't do. You can't afford it.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: お金貫わなきゃ〓められないよウチも〓売だからね
original_en:
This ain't enough! Whaddaya tryna pull?
This is a business, ya know!

speaker: Owner
original_jp: う～ん…ちょっとお金足りないわね…〓いだらまた来てね～
original_en:
Hmm... Looks like you're a little short.
Come back when you have the money!

speaker: Owner
original_jp: お〓様 代金が若干足りないようですので今回はちょっと…
original_en:
I'm afraid we require full payment
in advance in order to allocate rooms.
